en: Nyeh? Can I help you?

Oh, Shuichi. What's up?
Do you need my magic?

Nyeh? What? 
Did you come to invite me?

My magic isn't tricks. How many 
times do I need to tell you?

In my next show, I'll shock the 
audience right outta their seats.
Spend time together
Never mind
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What would you like to do with Himiko?
Spend time together
Go on a date
Never mind
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What would you like to do with Himiko?

You want me to teach you magic?
Well, it's not easy, but...

It's possible you're a spy sent 
by a dark mage, so...

First, I'm gonna do a simple test 
to make sure you're not a spy.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent the next hour demonstrating that
I was not, in fact, a spy for a dark mage.

So you want me to try using my 
magic to get us out of this academy?
Sorry, but I already tried that.

I almost did it, but I couldn't quite 
pull it off with my current spell list.

But if my master was here, we could 
definitely escape with his magic...

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time listening to Himiko
praise her master.

I don't mind spending time with you, 
but how will it benefit my magic?
Well? Explain it to me, magically.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time convincing Himiko that hanging
out was a good idea, magically speaking.
You understand, right?

My magic isn't tricks! 
You believe it's real, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time magically saying that
I magically believe in Himiko's magic...
<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko and I grew a little closer today.
